title: Decent extras, comfort and performance
summary: Reviews in this topic describe the car as offering decent equipment, comfort, fuel economy and performance, but many fragments are too mild or purely descriptive to support a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise included extras, comfort, decent mpg and strong or responsive performance.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments use mild wording like "decent" for infotainment, power, performance, options, extras and economy without enough context to confirm clear praise or criticism.

limitations: Many examples rely on vague terms such as "decent," which limits how confidently sentiment can be interpreted.
The topic spans several aspects including extras, infotainment, comfort, performance and economy rather than one tightly focused subject.
Examples are limited, so stronger conclusions about which aspect matters most are not supported.
